question: Can pre-outcome measurements predict which task, skill, or feedback proposal improves later financial work without creating a protected-case or control regression?
decision_unit: candidate experience carrier by target contract
phases: fit and score with complete source holdout
freeze one untouched source or panel before outcome extraction
run a two-round native skill-or-task proposal loop
compare with matched model-weight training when warranted
